audience: businesses that use Rinkel as their cloud phone system

useCases.title: Find missed calls and repeat callers
useCases.text: Lists calls with date, direction, status (answered, missed, voicemail), duration and numbers, so you can find missed calls and numbers that called more than once.

useCases.title: Check new voicemails
useCases.text: Counts the voicemails not played yet and lists them with caller, date and length. Can also give a temporary link to listen to one.

useCases.title: Read a call transcription or get a recording link
useCases.text: Gets the transcription of a call, if the account has AI insights, or a temporary link to stream or download the call recording.

useCases.title: Add or change a note on a call
useCases.text: Adds a note to a call record, or replaces the text of an existing note. Everyone who sees the call can see the note.

useCases.title: Look up, add or update a contact
useCases.text: Finds the contact that owns a phone number, creates a contact, or updates one. Contacts are shared with everyone in the account.

useCases.title: Block or unblock a phone number
useCases.text: Blocks a number, anonymous callers or a prefix such as +31* from calling any of the account's numbers, or removes a number from the block list.
